messages:
tanya: Heads-up team 1 1 We got the AstraCompute co-marketing request. They want a solution brief, marketplace tile, and a short hardware integration note for our SI pack. Need quick asset QA before we send to them.

ben: Thanks. Do we have Astra SVGs in RGB and CMYK? They mentioned print-safe colors for the datasheet.

omar: Partner uploaded `Astra_logo_v2.svg` but it includes gradients and a shadow. Partner agreed to provide a flat lockup today. Forwarding when I get it.

yuki: For marketplace tiles: 1024x1024 PNG (light/dark), 1200x675 hero image, and 600x600 thumbnail. Need both transparent and solid bg versions. Also provide 3:2 and 16:9 variants.

rade: Design note: keep partner mark at 12% width of the hero, left-aligned with 24px clearspace. Do not crop their wordmark. If we overlay CTA button, use semi-opaque black/white strip (16% opacity).

assets-bot: Reminder: upload destination is /partnerships/astracompute/assets. Current upload token expires in 6h. Use `rpush assets` to submit.

ben: Accessibility ask: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for any text over the hero image. Provide SVGs with title/desc tags and a plain-language alt text for each image.

omar: Also need alt copy in EN, FR, JP. Partner provided EN and JP drafts; I'll request FR from their comms lead.

yuki: Localization: FR PDF date format DD/MM/YYYY. JP copy needs full-width punctuation check. For fonts, Inter + Noto Sans JP fallback recommended.

legal-bot: Legal checklist: do not modify partner logo, include trademark statement exactly as provided, and route final bundle through legal review (24-48h). Embargo policy: any joint announcement requires 72h pre-approval.

rade: Question on trademark line 1 partner-provided line is: "AstraCompute4 is a trademark of AstraLabs, Inc." Legal: ok to append "Used with permission"?

legal-bot: Append is fine but confirm partner sign-off. Keep symbol ordering and spacing identical to their spec.

tanya: Good call. I'll confirm the exact trademark glyph and spacing with Astra comms.

ben: For the solution brief: target 2 pages, ~600 words, include one architecture diagram and one customer quote. Architecture diagram must be an SVG export and separate PNG. We'll need a short 50-word blurb for the marketplace summary too.

omar: Customer quote: partner offered a quote from NodeBank. We need to shorten to 1-2 sentences and remove identifying account numbers.

yuki: Design deliverables timeline: draft visuals by EOD today, final exports by noon tomorrow to accommodate localization and legal.

rade: Press embargo: planned release 2026-04-12 09:00 PT. If that's the case, final assets need to be locked by 2026-04-09 23:59 PT for legal.

tanya: Noted. I'll ping Astra for trademark confirmation and the FR copy.

ben: One more technical ask: hardware partner requires we call out supported GPUs (A100, H100) and whether quantized models are validated. Provide a short compatibility table in the appendix.

omar: Eng can supply the table. I'll get it from eng-runtime and format as CSV for the appendix.

assets-bot: Upload checklist: [SVG flat lockup, PNG light/dark 1024x1024, PNG hero 1200x675 light/dark, 600x600 thumbnail, architecture SVG/PNG, alt texts EN/FR/JP, brief EN/FR/JP, trademark line confirmation].

legal-bot: Also include contact for takedown/brand issues: comms@astralabs.com and legal@astralabs.com.

tanya: All right. If no major blockers, I'll assemble the bundle and send to Astra with the embargo window and a note about the 72h approval requirement. Expect upload link here when ready. :white_check_mark: 

yuki: Thanks 1 I9ll start the hero treatments and run the contrast checks.

omar: Forwarding the partner flat SVG in 5m.

ben: Will queue localization and alt text placeholders.

rade: I'll draft the brief layout and CTA options ("Get started" / localized variants).

legal-bot: Final reminder: route final copy to legal for sign-off before sending to partner.

assets-bot: Token refreshed. You can upload assets now.
